purpose: Teach: テナント/争議/励まさ/数回/封じ/裏付ける/先代/小論文

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ビルの、本気で、絶対、テナント、絶対、契約、絶対、見直しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need you to review the building's tenant contracts thoroughly. This is serious.
lines.style: Direct, commanding opening. Clipped delivery on key nouns. Lean forward slightly. Weight behind each syllable—not raised, but unmissable. The tone of someone who expects immediate action.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。労働、本気で、絶対、争議、絶対、ない、絶対、よう、絶対、社員と、絶対、対話、絶対、続けております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We haven't had any labor disputes, and we're continuing our ongoing dialogue with staff. Thank you for trusting us with this.
lines.style: Steady, measured cadence. Respectful but not deferential. Each clause lands with quiet precision. Slight pause between updates—giving each point its due weight. Professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員、本気で、絶対、励まされ、絶対、る、絶対、職場、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: That's good. Keep that up. Make sure everyone feels genuinely supported in their work.
lines.style: Satisfied nod in the voice. Slightly softer than the first directive—approval mixed with expectation. Even pacing, but the warmth is visible now. This is both praise and instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品テスト、本気で、絶対、数回、絶対、繰り返して、絶対、品質、絶対、確認しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've conducted multiple rounds of product testing and verified the quality at each stage. Thank you for your confidence.
lines.style: Composed, methodical. Ticking off each verification like items on a checklist—thorough but not labored. Calm pride in the process itself. The tone of someone reporting back on work completed well.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 情報漏洩を、本気で、絶対、封じる、絶対、対策、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Data security is non-negotiable. I want that tightened immediately. Make it your priority.
lines.style: Sharp, focused tone. Slight hardening on the core demand. No room for interpretation here. Professional but emphatic—this matters differently than the rest.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の品質、本気で、絶対、データ、絶対、裏付ける、絶対、根拠、絶対、揃えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. Our quality standards are backed by solid data. We've assembled all the evidence we need to stand behind our work.
lines.style: Confident, steady rhythm. The tone of someone presenting evidence they've thoroughly prepared. Clear and deliberate—each point secured. Gratitude tucked underneath, not emphasized.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の、本気で、絶対、先代、絶対、社長の方針、絶対、引き継げ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Don't lose sight of the principles my predecessor built this company on. Carry that forward.
lines.style: Quieter, more reflective than before. Weight of legacy in the phrasing. Slower pace—this isn't a quick directive but a trust being passed down. Slight reverential undertone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人研修の、本気で、絶対、小論文、絶対、課題、絶対、優秀作、絶対、出てきております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our new hires are already producing excellent work—their training essays show real promise. We're building the right foundation.
lines.style: Warm satisfaction. The pace opens slightly—there's genuine pleasure here. Professional still, but noticeably less guarded. The tone of someone seeing the future take shape in the present.
